Thought: I apologize for the continued errors. Let me calculate this manually.

The pKa is defined as the negative logarithm (base 10) of the acid dissociation constant Ka.
pKa = -log10(Ka)

Given:
Ka = 1.38 × 10^-4

To calculate log10(1.38 × 10^-4), I can use the logarithm property: log(a × 10^b) = log(a) + b

log10(1.38 × 10^-4) = log10(1.38) + log10(10^-4) = log10(1.38) + (-4)

log10(1.38) is approximately 0.14

So, log10(1.38 × 10^-4) ≈ 0.14 + (-4) = -3.86

Therefore, pKa = -log10(Ka) = -(-3.86) = 3.86
